families.connection: Gradient methods inform map-prior sensitivity, not completed external validation.
Causality analysis is future validation context, not part of the current evidence package.
Integration/segregation metrics align with the macro-dynamics surrogate evidence layer.
Network-control language maps to model-level transition-energy proxies, not receptor-level proof.
Toolbox ergonomics can inform reproducibility demos, but no wrapped analysis is promoted as original evidence.
Consciousness-theory archives are context only; this repo does not settle GNW/IIT claims.
Entropy/temperature ideas are benchmark inspiration only unless independently implemented and tested.
Run-02/music analyses stay blocked for primary claims until motion/context controls pass.
Regional-homogeneity analyses are future sensitivity checks.
Receptor maps are prior layers and require null controls before claim promotion.
Receptor-enriched connectivity remains a biological-prior target behind spatial-null and external-data gates.
Teaching resources are secondary context and not thesis evidence.
Traveling-wave framing is future work unless a dedicated local implementation exists.

comparison_plan.label: CopBET entropy
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare entropy and complexity summaries against Stage 2 LSD-placebo target deltas and current macro-dynamics metrics.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: ROI or voxel data requirements; entropy/complexity metric names; atlas and run-inclusion assumptions; summary/statistical output tables
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Toolbox reproduction context only; entropy metrics do not become original thesis evidence until independently run and documented.

comparison_plan.label: Cortical gradients / BrainSpace
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare gradient shifts or aligned embeddings against local map-prior sensitivity and dynamic hierarchy evidence.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: FC matrices; gradient components; alignment method; spatial-null settings
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Gradient tooling informs sensitivity checks; it is not completed external validation by itself.

comparison_plan.label: Neuroreceptor priors / eigenmodes
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare receptor-prior components against A+B+C+D+E mechanism layers without promoting receptor-level realism.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Parcellated receptor matrices; principal/eigenmode components; map-source provenance; null-control requirements
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Receptor maps are priors and require null controls before any claim promotion.

comparison_plan.label: Ising thermodynamics and LZW complexity
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare temperature/complexity directionality against surrogate temperature, barrier, and repertoire proxies.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Condition-specific time-series arrays; binarization rule; Ising temperature estimates; LZW complexity outputs
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Use as benchmark inspiration unless the local derivatives and independent implementation are verified.

comparison_plan.label: LSD and music brain states
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare occupancy, transition, and dwell summaries against dynamic repertoire and hierarchy-routing layers.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Run-02/music inclusion policy; K-means state definitions; occupancy/dwell outputs; transition matrices
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Run-02/music claims remain blocked until local exclusion, motion, and context controls pass.

comparison_plan.label: Energy landscape / network control
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare state transition-energy summaries against local transition-barrier and control-energy proxies.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: State centroids; transition probabilities; structural-connectome provenance; control-energy metrics; spin-null requirements
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Network-control language stays model-level unless structural and receptor provenance is explicit.

comparison_plan.label: REACT receptor connectivity
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare receptor-enriched connectivity outputs against receptor-prior sensitivity gates.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: PET template requirements; grey-matter mask requirements; stage-1 receptor time series; stage-2 enriched FC maps
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: General toolbox context; not ds003059-specific biological validation without local aligned inputs.

comparison_plan.label: Dynamic integration / segregation
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare integration/segregation state summaries against current macro-dynamics surrogate evidence.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Time-varying FC windows; community/affinity settings; integration coefficients; state summaries
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Public method code supports proxy comparison only; MATLAB upstream execution is not assumed.

comparison_plan.label: GNW/IIT consciousness archive
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare anterior/posterior FC and integration summaries as context only, not as a consciousness-theory adjudication.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Code.zip MATLAB scripts; processed data requirements; 450-ROI FC matrices; integration effect-size outputs
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Context archive only; this repository does not settle GNW/IIT or cross-state consciousness claims.

comparison_plan.label: Traveling waves
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare wave-propagation summaries only after a dedicated local CPC implementation exists.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: CPC settings; surface/time-series requirements; wave direction/speed summaries; spatial-null requirements
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Supporting dependency only until a dedicated analysis implementation is verified.

comparison_plan.label: Mesoscale ReHo
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare local synchrony summaries against surrogate regional-stability proxies after independent reconstruction.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: Voxelwise ReHo map requirements; AFNI/JASP/MATLAB settings; local synchrony contrasts; statistical design
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: No verified public code; reconstruction stays future work unless scripts are found or authored independently.

comparison_plan.label: DLPFC Granger causality
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Compare directional-flow summaries only after code or a defensible independent reconstruction is available.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: fMRI/MEG derivative requirements; model-order choices; DLPFC/thalamus flow matrices; behavioral correlation inputs
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Author-only code; manual contact or independent reconstruction required before testing.

comparison_plan.label: Translational neuromodeling teaching resource
comparison_plan.comparison_target: Use as setup and DCM workflow reference, not as a primary ds003059 prior-art claim.
comparison_plan.extract_target_summary: setup conventions; DCM workflow prerequisites; LSD/placebo analysis matrices; teaching-resource limitations
comparison_plan.claim_boundary: Secondary/pedagogical source; do not treat as a primary reproducibility target.

comparison_guardrail: Dry-run and compare/extract planning only. Do not execute upstream analysis code, download large archives, or copy external implementations into production modules.
claim_guardrail: Prior-art repositories are reproducibility context and inspiration. They are not copied into local analyses, and wrappers are not presented as original thesis evidence.
